title: Winnings
subtitle: What AFC owes you from wagers. Withdraw it to your bank; nothing is paid in here.
overview.frozen: Your Winnings are frozen: {reason} Contact support.
overview.empty: Nothing here yet. Winnings and refunds land here when a market settles.
overview.verifyNudge: Confirm your WhatsApp number and connect Discord to unlock withdrawals.
withdraw.title: Withdraw to your bank
withdraw.intro: Minimum {min}. AFC approves withdrawals by hand; transfers usually land within an hour of approval.
withdraw.noAccounts: Add the bank account you want paid into. We confirm the name with the bank.
withdraw.requested: Withdrawal requested. AFC will approve it shortly.
withdraw.locked: Confirm your WhatsApp number and connect Discord first.
withdraw.cancelled: Withdrawal cancelled. The money is available again.
history.title: Every movement
limits.title: Play limits
limits.intro: Set caps on what you stake and lose. Lowering a cap applies at once; raising one takes effect after 24 hours.
limits.cooloffIntro: No wagering for a number of days. It ends by itself.
limits.excludeIntro: No wagering for months. It cannot be shortened once set, by you or by AFC.
limits.excludeConfirmBody: For {months} months you will not be able to place a wager, and this cannot be undone or shortened.
limits.excludeActive: You are excluded from wagering until <time></time>.
limits.help: If wagering is a problem for you, talk to someone you trust. AFC support can also freeze your account on request.
verify.title: Verify to withdraw
verify.intro: Withdrawals need a confirmed WhatsApp number and a connected Discord account. Wagering only needs your date of birth.
verify.done: You are verified. Withdrawals are unlocked.
verify.ageMissing: Add your date of birth on your profile.
verify.ageUnder: You are under {min}. Wagering is not available to you.
verify.whatsappUnconfirmed: {number} is on your profile, not confirmed yet.
verify.whatsappMissing: Add a WhatsApp number on your profile.
verify.codeAlready: A code is already on its way.
verify.changeNumber: Wrong number? Change it on your profile, then confirm again.
